title: Opening Rules of the Twin Phase Student
summary: Opens the school's paired phases to a Warrior with half glows and matched wakes and a closing fall of the twin moon.

title: Hawk-Eye Manual of the Basin Tide
summary: Shows a Xiantian student how to pool the field's pull in a basin and stoop it on a foe like a hawk.

title: Treatise of the Core Moon and the Azure Sky
summary: Draws the moon's pull from the formed core to sweep a whole sky of foes into an orbit around the user.

title: First Oath-Book of the Wind Tide
summary: Gives a Warrior the first oath of the wind tide with sworn tugs and held eclipses and a closing oath of the tide.

title: Canon of the Open Moon
summary: A Xiantian canon of the moon worked in plain sight with no wall or cover and a pull that does not weaken in the open.

title: Book of the Oathcore and the Long Tide
summary: Joins the sworn oath to the formed core and sends a tide a very long way ending in an unending pull.
